correctness.rationale: PASS: Every nonempty convex subset C of [2]x[n] has unique canonical downclosure J and I=J\C; J and I are ideals and maximal J elements lie outside I. Summing two-row row-prefix ideals gives N_n=(n^4+4n^3+17n^2+14n+12)/12. For an arbitrary poset a support is shattered iff it contains no strict 3-chain: convex hull of each trace is its up/down closure intersection. Two-row three- and four-point chain-free support counts yield the polynomial and VCdim 2,3,4 by n. Independent brute convex enumeration plus full trace checks passed n<=6. Two incomparable row strips support independent endpoint threshold trees, giving lower Ldim 4log2 n-O(1), while |C| gives 4log2 n+O(1). The submitted exact n<=10 Ldim table comes from a mathematically exhaustive exact version-space recursion with inspected verifier and stored witness certificate; independent executable replay this run covered n<=6, not 7..10. Larger-n exact Ldim not claimed.
